text:
Zara Ng: hey all! Zara here, joining design ops today. Im a big boardgame nerd, bring a loud vintage mechanical keyboard (with obnoxious click), and occasionally a portable bluetooth turntable. Mostly remote but will be in SF Mon/Wed. Any rules about bringing a turntable to the lounge for low-key vinyl afternoons? also where do people stash tabletop games? :wave:
Keiko: welcome Zara!! Vinyl afternoons = awesome. The lounge has a small sound policy (no speakers past 5pm) but bluetooth headphone-friendly setups are fine. We keep a games cabinet in the kitchen labeled "COLLECTIVE"  feel free to add a box! :record:
Hugo Santos: hiya and welcome! re: keyboard noise  we have a cluster of "keyboard allies" in the east wing, but if you prefer quieter neighbors, reserve a focus space for crunch times. also ping facilities to request a power strip if youre bringing the turntable.
Priya Singh: welcome!! We do monthly game nights on the last Thursday — great for meeting folks. If you have 2-player games, bring them. :game_die:
Zara Ng: thanks!! will add a small set of eurogames to the cabinet. also curious if anyone has artisan keycap recommendations? Im tempted to swap in some pastel sets.
Alex Rivera: Welcome Zara! If youre into keycaps, check out @dangos stash in #random, they did a group buy last month. Also FYI badge & laptop provisioning are done by 10:00 per onboarding schedule.
welcome-bot: Reminder: complete IT checklist (https://redwood.example/it-onboard) within 72 hours to ensure laptop & badge delivery.
Zara Ng: perfect, thanks for the tips — excited for game night and vinyl afternoons. Mochi-free snacks will be provided. :upside_down_face:
Keiko: also quick poll: preferences for the first game night  Ticket to Ride, Sushi Go, or Azul? vote with emoji :train: :sushi: :flower: 
Hugo Santos: :train: for longform, :sushi: for quick rounds, :flower: if you like pattern puzzles.
Priya Singh: :sushi: because Im hungry.
Zara Ng: :flower: dreamy pastel keycaps and tile-laying vibes.
Alex Rivera: see you at the lobby at 6pm on Thursday!"
